description.value:
You believe information wants to be free. Whether this means going out of your way to program or support open-source software or participating in illegal piracy, you firmly believe capitalist gatekeeping is anathema to technological progress. Whether inspired by anti-capitalist ideals, the generous spirit of Triune, or simply not having the resources to pay for overpriced software suites, you've honed your ability to scour the infosphere for databases of useful tools and information.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Open-Source Research] skill feat.
